#!/bin/bash
set -e  # exit immediately if any command fails

# Get OS version
version=$(grep '^VERSION_ID=' /etc/os-release | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '"')

# Check version not empty
if [ -z "$version" ]; then
    echo "Failed to get OS version"
    exit 1
fi

# Get OS ID
id=$(grep '^ID=' /etc/os-release | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '"')

if [ -z "$id" ]; then
    echo "Failed to get OS ID"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Version: $version"
echo "ID: $id"

inputs.name: command
inputs.value:
set -euo pipefail

# Detect distro
distro=$(grep -E '^ID=' /etc/os-release | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '"')

# Install required packages (bzip2 + openscap-scanner)
install_packages() {
  if [[ "$distro" == "rhel" ]]; then
    sudo dnf install -y -q bzip2 openscap-scanner
  elif [[ "$distro" == "sles" ]]; then
    sudo zypper --non-interactive install -y bzip2 openscap >/dev/null
  else
    echo "Unsupported distro: $distro. Expected 'rhel' or 'sles'."
    exit 1
  fi
}

# Ensure required tools exist
if ! command -v bzip2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v oscap >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Installing required packages..."
  install_packages
fi

# Validate oscap installation
if ! command -v oscap >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: oscap is not installed even after attempting installation."
  exit 1
fi

# Process OVAL file
mkdir -p oscap
cd oscap

if [[ ! -f "oval.xml.bz2" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: oval.xml.bz2 not found in oscap directory."
  exit 1
fi

rm -f oval.xml result.html
bzip2 -dc oval.xml.bz2 > oval.xml

echo "Running OpenSCAP scan..."

# Run oscap scan
if ! oscap oval eval --report result.html oval.xml; then
  echo "OpenSCAP evaluation failed."
  exit 1
fi

echo "Scan complete. Report generated: oscap/result.html"
exit 0

meta.description: Copy of IBM's RHEL_SCAN_OSCAP_GRYPE (v2.2 sample) without the Grype step: scans RHEL machines over SSH with OpenSCAP against Red Hat's OVAL feed, converts the report to Concert's vm_scan CSV and ingests it. create_app_deploy_sbom defaults to false because php-portal's application and deploy SBOMs are loaded separately (re-sending an application SBOM without its components disassociates them). Sends resource_reference_id (host name) so zero-vulnerability scans archive the host findings; vmConfig defaults to concertuser/php-portal-vmconfig.
